operations.description: Retrieve a list of all possible flights (both direct and connecting) between two airports on a given date. Routes are available for today and up to days in the future.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] cargo route from date product code by origin and destination [PATH] cargo route [PARAMS] accept code date destination from origin product [SCHEMA]

operations.description: With this tracking service you can easily retrieve your shipment or flight status information.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] cargo shipment tracking by awb prefix and awb number [PATH] cargo shipment tracking [PARAMS] a accept number prefix wb [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME] offers lounges by location [PATH] offers lounges [PARAMS] accept cabin class code lang location tier [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME] offers seatmaps destination date cabin class by flight number and origin [PATH] offers seatmaps [PARAMS] accept cabin class date destination flight number origin [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Status of all arrivals at a given airport up to 4 hours from the provided date time.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] operations flightstatus arrivals by airport code and from date time [PATH] operations flightstatus arrivals [PARAMS] accept airport code date from limit offset time [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Status of all departures from a given airport up to 4 hours from the provided date time.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] operations flightstatus departures by airport code and from date time [PATH] operations flightstatus departures [PARAMS] accept airport code date from limit offset time [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Status of flights between a given origin and destination on a given date.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] operations flightstatus route date by origin and destination [PATH] operations flightstatus route [PARAMS] accept date destination limit offset origin [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Status of a particular flight (boarding, delayed, etc.).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] operations flightstatus by flight number and date [PATH] operations flightstatus [PARAMS] accept date flight limit number offset [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Scheduled flights between given airports on a given date.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] operations schedules from date time by origin and destination [PATH] operations schedules [PARAMS] accept date destination direct flights from limit offset origin time [SCHEMA]

operations.description: List all aircraft types or one specific aircraft type.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] references aircraft by aircraft code [PATH] references aircraft [PARAMS] accept aircraft code limit offset [SCHEMA]

operations.description: List all airlines or one specific airline.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] references airlines by airline code [PATH] references airlines [PARAMS] accept airline code limit offset [SCHEMA]

operations.description: List the 5 closest airports to the given latitude and longitude, irrespective of the radius of the reference point.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] references airports nearest by latitude and longitude [PATH] references airports nearest [PARAMS] accept lang latitude longitude [SCHEMA]

operations.description: List all airports or one specific airport. All airports response is very large. It is possible to request the response in a specific language.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] references airports by airport code [PATH] references airports [PARAMS] accept airport code lang lhoperated limit offset [SCHEMA] airport resource response

operations.description: List all cities or one specific city. It is possible to request the response in a specific language.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] references cities by city code [PATH] references cities [PARAMS] accept city code lang limit offset [SCHEMA]

operations.description: List all countries or one specific country. It is possible to request the response in a specific language.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] references countries by country code [PATH] references countries [PARAMS] accept code country lang limit offset [SCHEMA]
